content: Electron multithreading docs: Node worker_threads work in main process, not renderer; Web Workers can have nodeIntegrationInWorker but native .node modules must not be loaded in workers (process.dlopen not thread safe, assume single-threaded); Electron built-in modules unavailable in workers. Native addon vs WASM: both offload CPU work; addon stays in main-process event loop; WASM runs in renderer/worker with zero-copy access from JS/WebGL.
